protocol.rule: Initial50/50 capital in two independent strategy accounts; no subsequent transfers between accounts. Combined NAV=.5*NAV239120+.5*NAVClaude.
protocol.inherited_model: Saved common US Open execution and same-day Close NAV; zero explicit trading costs; KRWcash; previous-US-session FX Close as open FX proxy; dividends/taxes excluded.
protocol.selection_status: Fixed post-research diagnostics, not independent validation or a new winner search.
protocol.segment_policy: June-July/August-September metrics on continuous accounts inherit earlier holdings and drifting sleeve weights. FreshAugust starts both accounts at cashNAV1 and then splits initial capital50/50.
protocol.drawdown_policy: End-of-US-day KRW NAV including initialNAV1; not intraday drawdown.
protocol.daily_reset_policy: The .5*rA+.5*rB path is retained only as a separate diagnostic; it resets sleeve capital every preceding Close and is not the no-transfer rule.
protocol.correlation_policy: Report Pearson daily simple-return correlations over full history, fixed March6 onward, and June-July. Full-history correlation includes early all-cash zero-return days of239120; March6 onward is a fixed comparison window, not a guarantee of full exposure every day.
protocol.claim_scope: The original +232%/-16%/.52 mixture calculation was not located in compare_codex.py, so its exact combination method is unconfirmed. Daily resetting is an explicitly separate hypothetical diagnostic, not an assertion about the original method. Common-engine paths do not reproduce the original construction.

constant_daily_50_50_reset_diagnostic.interpretation: Arithmetic mean of component daily returns; implies resetting account capitals to50/50 every preceding Close. Not the requested no-transfer mixture, and not replayed US-open execution.
